summary:
SpeechGPT is a client-only voice chat app for talking with ChatGPT. The open conversation in the seeded data is "Last week in CDMX – plans". I saved 4 views:
(1) chat-workspace: the conversation sidebar (search, starred favorites, conversation history with message counts), the open chat with markdown replies, voice and speech controls, and the message input with Record and Send buttons.
(2) settings-chat: the Settings dialog on the Chat section (OpenAI API key, host, model, default system role).
(3) settings-synthesis: speech output settings (service, language, rate and pitch sliders, voice).
(4) settings-recognition: speech input settings (Chrome-only warning, recognition service, Azure region and access key, language, continuous-recognition toggle).

For views 2–4, the Settings menu button is clicked by its screen position because it has no accessible name. The app remembers the last open conversation between visits, so the replay steps for view 4 click "Last week in CDMX – plans" first. View 3 has no such step, but it replayed correctly.

Skipped:
- The menu on each conversation (Like, Edit, Delete): the harness rejected it as too close to the main view. Edit only renames the conversation in the sidebar.
- The About dialog: just an intro, links and a version number.
- Other conversations: same layout as the main view.
